acceptance_criteria.AC-WF-1: Every Campaign 10 command-level test, profile, benchmark, candidate, review, and closure gate has an immutable attempt record and the workflow validates with zero errors.
acceptance_criteria.AC-BASE-1: The Campaign 8 selected fingerprint, protected inputs, environment, final matrix, inherited routes, and target profiles are verified before candidate source changes.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CORRECT-1: A retained candidate has zero failed elements with no error, OOM, unauthorized skip, route change, or missing fused call in direct, expanded-seed, stress, neighbor, and broader gates.
acceptance_criteria.AC-PERF-1: A retained candidate provides about five-percent reproducible target or profile benefit, or material launch/memory benefit, with drift and every cost disclosed.
acceptance_criteria.AC-BOUNDARY-1: Fusion remains exact to one measured runtime/model row; adjacent shapes and unsupported execution preserve Campaign 8 behavior.
acceptance_criteria.AC-EVIDENCE-1: Raw samples, accuracy/error totals, latency, memory, backend/fusion/profiler counts, environment, hashes, fingerprint, and command wall time bind to the candidate.
acceptance_criteria.AC-REVIEW-1: Every surviving candidate receives provenance, correctness, performance, boundary, memory, maintenance, and devil's-advocate review.
acceptance_criteria.AC-RELEASE-1: Only approved winners remain and final, broader, inherited-route, test, documentation, workflow, graph, and tree gates are current.
